title: Recycling vs Landfill Diversion Rate
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=recycling:weight
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(stream="recycle",kg,0))) as recycled, sum(kg) as total by _time
| eval diversion_pct=round(100*recycled/total,1)
| sort - _time
description: Measures what share of your household waste is diverted from landfill into recycling and compost.
value: A diversion rate turns a vague green intention into a number you can improve, load by load.
implementation: Ingest weighed waste streams into `index=personal`; compute the diversion rate.
visualization: Column chart of monthly landfill-diversion rate.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much of your rubbish you recycle instead of sending to landfill.
